**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge, after a hand check of the ghost colour on a light ground (UI part, not seen on screen).**

Reviewed at the high tier because refusals are a safety surface.

**Safety surface (the point of this review)**
- A part-way refusal still refuses. Every adoption is a `map_err` / `.with_ghost..` on an existing `Err` path. No site returns `Ok`, and the control flow is unchanged.
- The ghost cannot be posted or verified. It lives only inside `GenError::Ghosted { .. }`, which is an error variant and not a `Toolpath`. The consumers are `commands/operation/generate.rs:46` (a `CommandError::MachiningGhost`, display-only), `script/api.rs:149` (move count in the text, "it is not kept") and the UI `feedback_ghost`. None writes the ghost to the op cache, post or sim.
- `Ghost::of_moves` drops any ghost holding a non-finite move, and it caps the length. The "finite horizon" tails stay ghost-free.
- Match sites: the new `Ghosted` arms in `cross_spindle::in_world` and `picks::door_refusal` keep the refusal and its words. Without a shift to read, or when the ghost holds an arc, the ghost and spot are dropped, so nothing is drawn in the spindle frame. `body_judged::name_enclosure` now goes through `map_msg`, so the "(enclosure)" words survive a ghost-carrying refusal.
- No `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic!` added outside tests.

**Local results (PR merged with upstream/main e0cb0049 v0.18.0, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `gate quick --dry-run` plan, run per step | 3 steps |
| motion: lib + 19 suites (incl. `refusal_ghost`, `trochoid_slot`, `control_comp`, `turning_*`, `pocket3d_hsm`) | all ok (lib 189 passed) |
| app: lib + 20 suites (incl. `tool_body_judged`, `plasma_profile`, `probe_*`, `drilling_cross_*`) | all ok (lib 112 passed) |
| ui (CWD `crates/ui`): lib, `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `theme_files` | ok (lib 531 passed, 5 ignored) |
| `clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

No build.rs, `.github/`, scripts, process files or dependencies touched. No snapshot PNG or `CHANGELOG.md` edits in the PR. Goldens untouched. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #871`; the decision file is in `docs/decisions/`.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Maintainer hand check needed. The ghost colour is pinned only by `the_ghost_reads_on_the_light_ground_and_keeps_its_dark_tones` (3:1 contrast, dark tones byte-identical). Please look at a refused op's ghost on the light theme, and confirm the dark theme is unchanged.
2. As the PR says, circular, contour `push_span`, ladder, plasma, probing and turning ghosts have no trigger test each. Only bore pins the mechanism. The edits are one-liners on error paths, so I accept that. The follow-up #1015 covers the rest.
3. `contour.rs` (434) and `trochoid_slot.rs` (405) were already over 400 lines before this PR and grow by a few lines. Not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c327ad97fbc4c21657643a88ebeb59b682be8b5f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so it merges at the next cut).

Reviewed at the high tier because it touches generator refusal paths (safety floor). The head was trial-merged with current `origin/main` (e0cb0049). The merge was clean.

### What looks good
- **The ghost is display-only. That has not changed.** The storage and readers are the ones from #861. `machining()` (`crates/app/src/commands/operation/generate.rs:46`) turns a ghosted refusal into `CommandError::MachiningGhost`. The UI keeps it as `feedback_ghost` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:3208`) and draws it only through `State::refusal_ghost` (`crates/ui/src/interact.rs:920`). The operation still gets no cache, and the post gate never sees it. The existing ui test `a_refused_generation_draws_its_ghost_and_caches_nothing` still passes.
- **No refusal changed when it fires.** I checked all 13 generator sites: bore, circular, contour (two sites), trochoid slot (two), the 3-D ladder, plasma (five), probing, turning form and turning blade. Each one only adds `.with_ghost(..)` or `.map_err(|e| e.with_ghost_moves(..))` to an error that already existed. None changed its condition, its words, or when it fires, and none became a partial success. `with_ghost_moves` passes `Empty`/`Geo` and already-ghosted errors through unchanged, and `Display` is identical, so every message stays the same.
- **The ghost-aware matches are safe.** I searched the whole workspace for matches on `GenError::Invalid`/`At` outside tests. The only ones left are `cross_spindle::in_world` and `picks::door_refusal`, and both now handle `Ghosted`. Neither can fall through to a success path: `door_refusal` still returns only words, and `in_world` still returns an error. The `name_enclosure` fix via `map_msg` is a real catch.
- **Frames.** Every adopting generator's success path either has no frame or uses only the 3+2 `world_path` map that `run_job` already applies to ghosts (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:50-53`). The one generator with an area turn (Face) is correctly left listed as owed (#1015). `cross_spindle` drops a ghost that holds arcs rather than shift arc centres. That is the conservative choice.
- **Goldens are untouched.** `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat -- crates/app/tests/golden` is empty, and `golden_cl` and `conformance` pass. No snapshot PNGs changed.
- **The overlay vertex budget is still enforced.** `ghost_lines` and its `MAX_OVERLAY_VERTICES` guard / `diag_warn!` are unchanged, and the diff adds no `println!`/`eprintln!`.
- The dark-ground colours are byte-identical, and the light-ground fade is pinned by a WCAG 3:1 test across every colour-vision palette.
- No new dependencies, and no build.rs, scripts, `.github` or process-file changes. `unwrap`/`expect` appear only in tests. The decision file is present. The PR body is complete: `Changelog:`, `Fixes #871`, and a "not exercised" list.

### Local results (merged with main)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --tests` (37 binaries, incl. `refusal_ghost`, `trochoid_slot`) | 524 passed, 0 failed, 43 ignored |
| app `tool_body_judged` | 8 passed |
| app `golden_cl` | 25 passed |
| app `conformance` | 6 passed |
| app `refusal_ghost` | 4 passed |
| app lib, `operation::{cross_spindle,picks,body_judged}` | 3 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 531 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

This checkout uses `core.autocrlf=true`, and no line-ending failures showed up.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (non-blocking)
1. `ghost_colour` (`crates/ui/src/refusal_ghost.rs:41`) now calls `theme::current()` once per ghost move, which takes an `RwLock` read each time, for up to `Ghost::MAX_MOVES` (100k) moves per overlay build. You could read the ground once in `ghost_lines` and pass it to `ghost_ink`. For the same reason, the ui test `a_refused_generation_draws_its_ghost_and_caches_nothing` now depends on the global theme staying the same between drawing and checking. A parallel test that switches the theme could make it flaky.
2. Only bore has a test for its own trigger. The other new sites (circular, contour, ladder, plasma, probing, turning) are one-line error-path attachments, and your body says so. A follow-up pinning test per site would guard against a later edit that drops the ghost or moves the refusal.
3. `contour.rs` (434 lines) and `trochoid_slot.rs` (405) were already over the ~400-line guide, and this grows them by 4 and 2 lines.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
